verdict.rationale: Docs confirm transcripts are diarized (fellow-docs-36) and searchable (fellow-docs-21), but there is no evidence describing real-name matching of speakers (e.g., mapping diarized speaker IDs to actual named meeting attendees) rather than generic labels.
